ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light grey) surface (~70%) with high-contrast low-intensity (black/dark grey) markings concentrated in the central peduncle area and scattered focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity V-shaped region at the peduncle insertion; numerous discrete, small dark circular blobs distributed across both lobes; irregular dark pigmentation bands along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 50-60 degrees and a sharp apical vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys localized along the entire linear boundary from the notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature from the median notch extending distally, transitioning to irregular geometric protrusions at the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of 12-15 distinct circular high-contrast pixel clusters (dark outlines with lighter centers) consistent with barnacle attachment sites, scattered across the mid-region of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned dark linear disruptions; notably three diagonal rake-like marks on the left lobe and one extended horizontal mark on the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Massive, high-texture biological encrustations (barnacle colonies) localized on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes, significantly altering the natural geometric contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-intensity specular reflections and pixel-level noise caused by active water spray across the lower central fluke surface.
